title: This is so soft and comfortable.
text: This is so soft and comfortable.. If you need a hard mattress, this isn't for you.  This is a soft mattress pad.  It's thick and comfortable.  I would buy again.

product_metadata.title: Marsail 3 Inch Memory Foam Mattress Topper, Queen Mattress Topper Cooling Gel Ventilated Design, Bed Topper with CertiPUR-US Certified
features: Memory Foam cooling mattress topper queen

CertiPUR-US & OEKO-TEX Certified: The memory foam mattress topper is made of CertiPUR-US certified materials which means premium quality that is very skin-friendly. Furthermore, OEKO-TEK certifies our quality is above average standards so you will defiantly receive the best quality on the market.

Soft & Resilient: Had enough of sleeping on a hard, old, and worn-out mattress's and waking up with body pains all over? Say no more! Add the 3 inch mattress pad on top of your existing mattress, soft yet resilient is the best fit for your body and soul.

Clean Way to Sleep!: What most people don't know about the memory foam mattress topper, the foam reduces skin flakes and sweat meanwhile lowering bed scents that would accumulate into your mattress. We want our sleepers to know, it's not just comfy, it's hygienic.

Needing a Beauty Sleep?: The mattress topper is a gel-infused memory foam layer of softness, curve, and coolness to your bed, furthermore a cool air tunneled design to prevent sweat and fewer spots while reducing skin rashes!

Protect Your Expensive Mattress: Unlike cheaper options, our 3 inches memory foam mattress topper won’t flatten or bottom out over time, which makes it a good option for softening up and protecting your expensive mattress.
description: 3-inch gel memory foam ventilated mattress topper adapts to your body curves for personalized comfort and support to reduce aches and pains while you sleep regardless of sleeping position.
